studies.title: Digital Transformation for a Kuwait Retail Group
studies.challenge: A 30-store retail chain operating with disconnected POS, inventory, and e-commerce systems losing revenue to fragmented operations.
studies.strategy: Unified commerce platform integrating all channels with AI-driven demand forecasting and personalized marketing.
studies.implementation: Headless commerce architecture with real-time inventory sync, customer data platform, and automated marketing workflows.
studies.outcome: 38% increase in cross-channel revenue, 25% reduction in inventory costs, and 3x improvement in marketing ROI within 6 months.

studies.title: AI-Powered Claims Automation for a GCC Insurer
studies.challenge: Processing 10,000+ claims monthly with a 7-day average settlement time causing customer dissatisfaction and high operational costs.
studies.strategy: AI-driven claims triage with automated assessment for standard claims and intelligent routing for complex cases.
studies.implementation: Document AI for intake, ML models for damage assessment, integration with policy admin and payment systems.
studies.outcome: 60% of standard claims auto-settled within 24 hours, 45% reduction in processing costs, NPS increased by 28 points.

studies.title: Smart Fleet Management for Kuwait Logistics
studies.challenge: A logistics company with 200+ vehicles struggling with fuel waste, route inefficiency, and limited fleet visibility.
studies.strategy: IoT-connected fleet platform with AI-powered route optimization and predictive vehicle maintenance.
studies.implementation: GPS telematics hardware, custom fleet management dashboard, mobile driver app, and maintenance prediction engine.
studies.outcome: 22% reduction in fuel costs, 35% improvement in on-time delivery, and 50% fewer unplanned vehicle breakdowns.

studies.title: Healthcare Digital Platform for Multi-Clinic Provider
studies.challenge: Eight clinics operating with paper-based patient records and manual appointment scheduling causing long wait times.
studies.strategy: Cloud-based EHR with telemedicine integration, patient mobile app, and clinical analytics dashboards.
studies.implementation: HIPAA-aligned system with data migration, staff training, and phased rollout across all facilities.
studies.outcome: 35% reduction in appointment no-shows, 50% faster patient record retrieval, and 40% improvement in physician utilization.
